hero.h1: Expert Power Washing & House Washing in Apex, NC
hero.intro: Keep the Peak City pristine! If your Apex home is suffering from seasonal pollen build-up, heavy mold growth, or unsightly concrete stains, AAA Houston Pressure Washing, LLC is here to help.

intro_body: Serving the Apex community for over a decade, our fully insured crew knows exactly how to handle North Carolina's tough environmental elements. We don't believe in a one-size-fits-all approach — we inspect your home's siding and concrete surfaces to map out the safest, most effective cleaning plan.
services_heading: Tailored Exterior Cleaning Packages in Apex

services.body: We strip away bugs, spiderwebs, and thick mold layers using safe, low-pressure technology. Your siding and trim will look freshly painted without the cost of a repaint.
We remove slick organic buildup from your walking paths to ensure family and guests stay safe. Slippery walkways are a liability — we eliminate the hazard and restore a clean, bright surface.
High-powered surface cleaning that brightens your concrete and instantly lifts your home's neighborhood profile. We eliminate tire marks, oil stains, and embedded grime for a like-new finish.
